opportunities.title: Research Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) holding an independent research post; limited to one per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Provides up to £5000 for 12 months covering chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants aged 18 and over, UK or Republic of Ireland residents (or applying on behalf of an organisation registered in UK/ROI); project must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members, individuals and organisations to run chemistry-based engagement activities connecting communities with the chemical sciences. Rolling deadlines throughout 2026 with three rounds; final deadline 2 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC); applicants can be PhD students or researchers at any career stage, working in any sector or location.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers to establish and develop collaborations and networks beyond their own institution, including national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations. Funds research visits and organising meetings/workshops. Round 2 open 3 August to 21 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Chemists based in the UK or Ireland, or those outside these countries holding valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; must incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event by covering additional costs of care they usually provide. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund. Rolling applications.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Chemists based in the UK or Ireland, or those outside these countries holding valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; must require support relating to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to reduce accessibility challenges when attending professional events, covering equipment, services or personal expenses associated with meeting access needs for chemists with disabilities and ongoing health conditions. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund. Rolling applications.
